title: The Rocket Journey
description: This is a complete state-machine scrollytelling story. A rocket 🚀 sits at the bottom. As you scroll down, the rocket launches and leaves a trail of smoke particles behind it. As the rocket climbs higher, the sky darkens and stars begin to appear. Finally, the rocket disappears into 'DEEP SPACE'. Ultra Max Premium Pro Super Features and Ultra Max Premium Pro Super Animation, Graphic Effects.
